display.purpose: Doto 800. The name, the role and the claims on screens and title tiles. Capped by what fits four cells.

title.purpose: Doto 700. "Read more" and the next-case screen.

label.purpose: Doto 700, usually caps. Navigation, tags and control names. Capped by what fits two cells.

headline.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 600. Headings inside reading tiles.

body.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400 at a 37rem measure. Case-study prose.

small.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400, 14px. Fact labels, captions, table heads.

motion.name: scene-move
motion.purpose: Every tile in a home-page scene change. One path and one speed for all, so start order alone guarantees no overlap.

motion.name: lane-gap
motion.purpose: Delay between lanes in a scene change; random per transition, order from one of six patterns.

motion.name: wave-budget
motion.purpose: Maximum spread between the first and last tile of one lane.

motion.name: screen-power
motion.purpose: Screens switching off before a scene change and on after it.

motion.name: character-light
motion.purpose: The sector screen lighting and clearing its word.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Hover and state changes on tiles, the switch knob, the speaker grill.

breakpoints.name: stage
breakpoints.purpose: Five rows fill the viewport; the home page runs as a stage.

breakpoints.name: l8
breakpoints.purpose: Eight columns. Below the stage size they are square and the page scrolls.

breakpoints.name: l4
breakpoints.purpose: Four square columns; scenes drop their empty tiles.

components.name: Tile
components.description: A surface on the grid. Plain, or one control filling the whole tile.
components.css: .mx-tile { padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.name: Screen
components.description: The black ground carrying dot-matrix text. Sits below tiles so they can slide across it.
components.css: .mx-screen { padding: 1.5rem; color: #FFFFFF; font: 800 3rem Doto, monospace; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.name: Open tile
components.description: The orange tile that opens a case study. The most important control of each case scene.

components.name: Switch tile
components.description: A tile that is a switch: animation, sound. The knob's position carries the state as well as the colour.

components.name: Reading tile
components.description: A case-study section. Spans the whole grid rows its text needs; the text column is 37rem.
components.css: .mx-reading { display: block; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 1.5vw, 2.5rem); text-align: left; font: 400 1.1875rem/1.65 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The site is a mosaic of tiles on a black ground, like the face of a physical device. Tiles are surfaces; screens are the ground itself, showing dot-matrix text. A 4px gap is the only line. There is one orange. Doto is the voice; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is for reading.
keyCharacteristics: A grid computed for the device: five rows fill a wide viewport, and the column count follows.
Two objects only: tiles and screens.
A black ground in both themes; the theme changes what the tiles are made of.
One orange, never under white text.
The home page moves one scene per gesture; tiles start unevenly and cannot overlap.
Every animation can be switched off, and the page still works as a plain scroll.
Case-study text runs down the middle of the grid at a fixed measure.

rules.name: Black on orange
rules.body: On orange, text is always black. White on orange is 3.04:1 and is allowed only for a graphic, the arrow.

rules.name: Orange as text
rules.body: Use accent only on the ground. On a surface use accent-text. Never on tone-2, tone-3 or tone-4.

rules.name: Doto needs 7:1
rules.body: Its dots cover only part of each stroke. Ink on surface, tone-1 and tone-2; white on the ground; orange on the ground at display size.

rules.name: Doto fits the tile
rules.body: Doto is monospace, 0.6em a character, so the largest size that fits a tile is arithmetic. In the mosaic the size is capped by the cell width.

rules.name: Only the gap
rules.body: Tiles are separated only by the 0.25rem gap. Padding inside a tile is at least four gaps.

rules.name: Whole rows
rules.body: A tile is always a whole number of rows tall. A reading tile measures its text and spans what it needs.

rules.name: Never overlap
rules.body: In a scene change every tile follows the same path at the same speed, and none starts before the tile ahead of it.

rules.name: Different every time
rules.body: The order of the lanes and the breaks inside each lane are random per transition; the same pattern never runs twice in a row.

rules.name: Off means off
rules.body: With animations off there is no GSAP animation and no CSS transition, and the home page is a normal scrolling page.

dos: Do place every object on the grid with [column, row, width, height] for both layouts.
Do make a control fill its tile, with the focus ring inside.
Do carry state by position or shape as well as colour.
Do give screens their readable text separately from the split characters.
Do read colours only from the semantic tokens.
donts: Don't put white text on orange.
Don't set more than about twelve consecutive words in Doto.
Don't add space between tiles other than the gap.
Don't animate anything but transform and opacity.
Don't write a hex value outside tokens.css.
Don't publish an email address anywhere on the site.
